voiceover: <break time="1200ms"/> And one more lens. Gold. <break time="500ms"/> If you'd measured your groceries against gold's twelve-fold rise over this period... everything collapses toward zero. visual.description: The deflator indicator switches to 'GOLD'. All 6 lines collapse dramatically downward — from their minimum-wage positions high above 1.0, they plummet toward zero. Every single line ends well below 1.0 (all between 0.107 and 0.371). The visual effect should be striking: the chart that just showed catastrophe now shows everything as a bargain. Brief tally: '0 of 6: More expensive'. The animation should feel surreal — too good to be true. A small footnote appears: 'Gold: +1,155% since 2000'. The final line 'But no one buys eggs with gold' is punctuated by the gold deflator label fading slightly — suggesting its irrelevance.

notes: BRIEF AND PHILOSOPHICAL. This scene should feel like an afterthought — per the script note, 10-15 seconds of actual visual focus on gold. The 1200ms leading break provides transition time. The collapse animation should be fast (30 frames) and dramatic — the opposite of the slow drifts in earlier scenes. All values near zero create a visually flat chart near the bottom — which itself makes the point: gold makes everything look irrelevant. Don't linger. The footnote is dismissive in tone. The punchline 'no one buys eggs with gold' should land during the visual still.
